description: This is a static HTML file that constitutes the front-end interface for a database visualizer. It provides UI components for selecting databases, viewing tables, and displaying data fetched dynamically via API calls. The embedded JavaScript handles data fetching, table rendering, and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the current state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database entry to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a given database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data from a specific table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying tabular data with support for wide or nested content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content to show full data.
